Usage: headroom login status <account> [flags]

Print one account's started sign-in as JSON.

Prints the account's sign-in as start and finish print it: awaiting_code or exchanging while
it is live, and how it ended after — kept until the next start of the account; none when no
sign-in was ever started. It exits 0.

Arguments:
  <account>        The account whose sign-in to print.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.
      --version    Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and exit.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why
